player_prompt.intro:
Nge ujile Mubadi {player_id} mu Chopsticks. Ku nge kubasa, tchagua umwe wa:
  + Kukwata: '[attack M O]'  nge M=dyoko nge (0 ou 1), O=dyoko dya mona nge (0 ou 1).
    - Dyoko dya mona nge kubongololwa kwa dyoko nge; nge >=5, kubadilika 0.
  + Kuzinga:   '[split L R]'  kuzinga vidole vya nge mu L na R (L+R = vidole vya nge).
Vutula na kubasa kimoja kya mabasa aya.

invalid_move.opp_hand_dead: O muthu uala ni lukuaku lua mukuá {opp_idx}, uafú kiá.
invalid_move.split_sum: O ku uana o jimbandu, kua tokala kulondekesa kuila {total}.
invalid_move.split_no_change: O ku uana o jimbandu, kua-nda kuatekesa kuijiia se ua mu bhana valolo mba kana.
invalid_move.invalid_command: Kubasa kubululu. Usa “[attack M O]” ou “[split L R]”.

game_action.attack: P{player_id} akishambulia mkono wa P{opp_id} {opp_idx}: unatoka {opp_val} hadi {new_val}.

outcome.win: Dyoko zote mbili za mona nge kufwa.
outcome.draw: O jimbambe ja ku bhixila bhu kididi kiki, a ji tolola kiá.
